verdict.rationale: Foreloop coordinates agents such as Claude Code or Codex that claim approved tasks and open pull requests. Nothing in the evidence shows the product having an agent generate or run tests to check its own changes before proposing them. The closest features are adjacent: automatic product reviews and GitHub checks that run after a PR is opened (with '@foreloop retest'), and team skills carried into a run, which a user would have to write themselves.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent automatically generate and run tests to validate its own code changes before proposing them

citations.quote: Connect a repository and get automatic product reviews on your pull requests.
Push changes or have a repository writer comment @foreloop retest.
Each task contract carries the relevant skills into the run, so an agent starts with your team's expectations rather than being corrected afterwards.
